It is been 8 years since Rabi-Ribi release! I think it is time for a new Rabi-Ribi game!

Although the development of TEVI DLC is currently underway, other team members are building and coding the base game system, Saiste has already started designing characters. After the completion of TEVI DLC, my focus will shift to the development of a new project for Rabi-Ribi.

On new projects, we will adjust the composition of the team, production processes, and details of various aspects of game design based on the experience gained during the development of TEVI. For example, this time there will be multi programmers instead of just me.

The "Love Bunny" that I've posted on my Twitter in recent years will also merge into the new game project! The plot of the new game is set for a while, which are hinted in the "Before Next Adventure" DLC.

I am aiming for less dialog in the main plot. So basically, more dialogue about interaction between characters, aka girls doing cute and silly things in side content, and balance the dialogue in the main game content.

For gameplay of the new game, it is a secret for now. But I asked the artist to draw some cute and funny animations for the player character, for use during the map explorations.

[h1]Key Features[/h1]
Linear route, visual novel
A short but impactful story written in almost 70,000 words
Story brought to life with 12 unique characters, beautiful backgrounds and a wonderful soundtrack.
Available in English and Portuguese - Brazil languages 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3202207/9e1948feae416687d940c72fa0a95d5b6fe62e7e.jpg[/img]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/835130/Last_Stanza/]Last Stanza[/url]
[h1]Story[/h1]
Last Stanza is a slice of life, dramatic visual novel that deals with the consequences of a tragic event from different perspectives.
December, 2009. On a day in the last week of that month, I realized how slowly dripping tears had a shivering yet uneasy feeling. The coming of winter turned the air thin and cold. The clouds blocked out the sunlight that normally reached the ground making it seem as if the sun was absent.

Many days passed and life seemed to return to normal as if nothing had happened. To conceal my anger and confusion and slowly regain control of my thoughts, I opened my heart up to friends old and new to try at any cost to find a new place for myself.

But it is in peaceful moments such as these when even a single seemingly inconsequential action can set up a chain reaction like the endless waves of a once calm ocean turned violent, bringing to the shores of my mind the emotions I had thought were long locked away.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3202207/72a8c8d6663c8b583fb917c5a50187b79158a6c6.jpg[/img]

[h1]Story[/h1]
All Eve ever wanted was to protect and preserve the land, but after five years of being a ranger in Yosemite National Park, she’s just about ready to throw in the towel. The people are careless, her co-workers are annoying, and thanks to an increasingly tight budget she can hardly do her job. Fed up and burned out, Eve lashes out, but after being transferred to a remote cabin post in return, she only finds herself more uncertain of the value of being a ranger. Soon after arriving, three strange girls corner her in the cabin. Not only do they claim to live there, but they also say they’re the manifestations of Zion, Yellowstone, and Yosemite National Parks! Are these girls really who they say they are? Why is Yosemite so obsessed with her research? And why does one of them have a volcano on their head? Follow Eve as she gets closer with these spritely cuties that put the “natural” in “supernatural,” and maybe even discovers a new kind of love for the parks.

This is an occult yuri game created by members of 2ch, Seven days with the Ghost takes place at the girls-only Keisei Academy, in the modern era where magic exists alongside science.

notes.content:

"Is the order a DLC?" has been release and everything's 15% off for the whole week!
New areas to explore, new bosses, and new items are now on the menu!
Climb up Rabi-Rabi Ravine to play with Ribbon's friends, and head down to the Hall of Memories to reminisce about the past...
Erina also gets a working wardrobe to freely change between all her outfits!
http://store.steampowered.com/app/532021/RabiRibi__Is_the_order_a_DLC/

[h1]New UPRPRC Edition[/h1]
There's a new Super UPRPRC Edition in town which includes the new DLC.
Just as a refresher getting the UPRPRC gets you Rabi-Ribi with the new DLC, the full Soundtrack (that updates with new content) and the Artbook. That also means you get new (but experimental) difficulties, unused beta content, and a portrait viewer. Who knew you could put so many things in a digital artbook?
http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/591/RabiRibi_Super_UPRPRC_Edition/

[h1]Rabi Rabi Island Voting Contest[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11358524/b0eabe16330b60037ed4ff8368190d51a8659bfc.jpg[/img]
There are three weeks left until October 1st so there's still time to put in your ballots!
*Enter voting by pressing F1/F2 in the main menu!


[h1]Custom Map[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11358524/bb1f8991f264ef371309a155e6bd0b58b1500722.png[/img]
Also, we launched a test function. In this function, players can load their custom maps by pressing F5/F6 in the main menu. 
For more about creating custom maps, please visit one of these map editors by our great Rabi-Ribi speedrun community members:
 
https://wcko87.github.io/rabiribi-map-editing/  By wcko87 
https://github.com/D3nD3nD3n/rbrb-Map-Viewer  By d3n

*Custom map support was made because we were surprised to see map editors out there already.
The idea of this function is to make it easier to install and test out maps. This function might not be fully completed or supported in the future, but we hope Rabi-Ribi can make use of Steam Workshop in the future.

- Added launch option "-fullload" to load everything before the game display the first screen.
- Change some sound effects.
- Fixed text stopping advancing in "INSTANT" text speed or text skipping.
- Added new music tracks in "SOUNDTRACK DLC"
- Added new characters in "ARTBOOK DLC"
